title: Add Security Headers for Browser Protection
description: Implement HTTP security headers via HTML meta tags for the Jekyll site hosted on GitHub Pages to protect against XSS, clickjacking, and other common web attacks.

phases.name: Analysis & Planning
phases.description: Analyze current site resources and plan CSP policy

subtasks.title: Document all external resources
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive list of all external domains and resources used by the site for CSP whitelist: Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com), unpkg.com (Ionicons, PhotoSwipe), Google Analytics (googletagmanager.com, google-analytics.com), Formspree (formspree.io), Disqus (*.disqus.com)
subtasks.notes: Analysis complete - identified all external resources from head.html, default.html, google-analytics.html, contact-form, disqus-comments.html

phases.name: Implement Security Meta Tags
phases.description: Add security headers via HTML meta tags in the head include

subtasks.title: Create security headers include file
subtasks.description: Create a new _includes/security-headers.html file containing all security-related meta tags: Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy, and X-Content-Type-Options equivalent where possible
subtasks.notes: Created security-headers.html with Content-Security-Policy (including all external resources: Google Fonts, unpkg.com, Google Analytics, Formspree, Disqus), Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy meta tags

subtasks.title: Configure Content-Security-Policy
subtasks.description: Define CSP directives: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' unpkg.com www.googletagmanager.com www.google-analytics.com *.disqus.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' fonts.googleapis.com unpkg.com; font-src 'self' fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' www.google-analytics.com formspree.io; frame-ancestors 'self'
subtasks.notes: Updated CSP meta tag with specified directives: removed redundant Disqus domains (keeping only *.disqus.com wildcard), removed frame-src and form-action directives, added frame-ancestors 'self' for clickjacking protection. Note: frame-ancestors may not work in meta tags per GitHub Pages limitations.

subtasks.title: Add Referrer-Policy meta tag
subtasks.description: Add Referrer-Policy meta tag with 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin' to control referrer information sent to external sites
subtasks.notes: Referrer-Policy meta tag already implemented with 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin' value. Good balance between privacy and functionality. This was completed as part of subtask 2.1 when the security-headers.html file was initially created.

subtasks.title: Add Permissions-Policy meta tag
subtasks.description: Add Permissions-Policy to restrict browser features like camera, microphone, geolocation that the site doesn't need
subtasks.notes: Enhanced Permissions-Policy meta tag with comprehensive browser feature restrictions: camera, microphone, geolocation, interest-cohort (FLoC), payment, usb, magnetometer, gyroscope, accelerometer, ambient-light-sensor, autoplay, and display-capture. Provides defense-in-depth by restricting browser APIs not needed by the site.

subtasks.title: Include security headers in head.html
subtasks.description: Add {% include security-headers.html %} to the head.html include file near the top after charset
subtasks.notes: Successfully added {% include security-headers.html %} to head.html right after the charset meta tag (line 3). The security headers will now be included in all pages of the site.

phases.name: Configuration & Documentation
phases.description: Make security headers configurable and document for maintainability

subtasks.title: Add security settings to _data
subtasks.description: Create site/_data/security.yml with toggleable security settings and CSP configuration options
subtasks.notes: Allow easy enable/disable of security features without modifying templates

subtasks.title: Update security-headers.html to use config
subtasks.description: Modify security-headers.html to read from security.yml for flexible CSP configuration
subtasks.notes: Makes it easy to add new external resources without editing the include

phases.name: Testing & Validation
phases.description: Test security headers implementation and validate functionality

subtasks.title: Local build and test
subtasks.description: Build Jekyll site locally and verify security meta tags are present in generated HTML. Check that no CSP violations occur for existing functionality
subtasks.notes: Run jekyll build and inspect _site output, test in browser console for CSP errors

subtasks.title: Verify all site features work
subtasks.description: Test: Google Fonts load correctly, PhotoSwipe lightbox works, Google Analytics tracking works, contact form submits to Formspree, social share buttons work
subtasks.notes: All external integrations must continue working with CSP in place

subtasks.title: Document security headers in SECURITY.md
subtasks.description: Create SECURITY.md documenting the implemented security measures, CSP policy explanation, and how to modify for new external resources
subtasks.notes: Help future maintainers understand and modify security configuration

hosting_limitations: GitHub Pages does not support custom HTTP headers
Security headers must be implemented via HTML meta tags
X-Content-Type-Options cannot be set via meta tag
HSTS is automatically provided by GitHub Pages for HTTPS
frame-ancestors CSP directive not supported in meta tag (only via HTTP header)

final_acceptance: Content-Security-Policy meta tag present in all pages
Referrer-Policy meta tag present in all pages
All external resources (fonts, analytics, scripts) continue working
No CSP violation errors in browser console
Security configuration is documented and maintainable
